name: Teleport Pad
description: A simple, reusable pad that safely moves players to a linked destination part.
details: Connect pads with a Destination object value and let the server handle touches. A short debounce prevents repeated teleports while a character overlaps the pad.

scripts.name: Teleport.server.lua
scripts.description: Detects pad touches and moves characters.

instructions: Create a Part for the pad and add an ObjectValue named Destination pointing to the target Part.
Place this Script inside the pad Part.
Anchor both parts and ensure CanTouch is enabled.
notes: Destination must reference a BasePart in Workspace.
